thread:
incident-bot: [P1] Page: elevated 5xx on /generate. Detected spike at 12:06 UTC. Symptoms: gateway timeouts, 502/504, and backend 5xx traces referencing kv-prefix lookups.

maria (oncall): paging now — taking first responder. I'll triage, please post any quick mitigation steps.

mike (eng-runtime): seeing a cascade of cache misses + eviction churn on prefix shard 7. KV client logs show repeated checksum mismatches then rehydrate floods.

jin (ingress): traffic spike isn't unusual. Per-route rates steady. Errors correlate with prefix cache reads failing with 500s from kv-proxy.

elena (sre): bumping log level and attaching recent logs. If eviction storm, we should consider bypassing prefix cache for the hot route.

sam (prod-support): customer reports started ~12:05 UTC, multiple timeouts. impact: chat features degraded, some users seeing blank responses.

maria (oncall): plan: 1) enable cache-bypass for /generate route, 2) scale kv-proxy replicas +2, 3) apply short-term circuit breaker to prevent thundering herd to backing store. Who can flip the bypass?

mike (eng-runtime): I can flip bypass in 60s. Command (console):

```bash
POST /config/service/cache_bypass
{
  'route': '/generate',
  'enable': true,
  'ttl': 120
}
```

mike (eng-runtime): also opening an emergency canary to route traffic to model-variant v2 (lighter memory) as fallback.

jin (ingress): rolling bypass now... response: 202 accepted. propagating in 5s across edge.

incident-bot: Action: cache_bypass applied by mike at 12:09:21 UTC. Note: TTL 120s

elena (sre): scaling kv-proxy set to +2 replicas (kubectl scale). Logs show reduced checksum errors but backend 5xx still present. Applying CB: `503 if inflight>80` on kv-proxy.

sam (prod-support): observing customer error rate drop from 14%->6% in the last minute. Some lingering 504s though.

maria (oncall): good. runbook step: capture heap/profile and KV index snapshot for shard 7. mike please collect `kv-proxy` core dump if available.

mike (eng-runtime): uploading snapshot to s3://redwood-incident/5250007777/kv-snapshot.tar.gz

```text
tail /var/log/kv-proxy.log | grep "checksum" | tail -n 50
ERROR kv checksum mismatch shard=7 keyPrefix=... idx=2345 expected=0x1a2b got=0xdead
```

elena (sre): notes: looks like index stale->false positives causing evictions, then rehydrates flooding backend. Proposed mitigation: back-off rehydrate (exponential) + mark-healthy threshold.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigations in place. Next: prepare postmortem template and customer updates. Sam, can you draft status for affected customers? Include ETA: rolling mitigation in progress, workaround: retry after 3s, no data loss reported.

sam (prod-support): drafting now. Will ping #customer-updates when ready. ETA to customers 20m.

jin (ingress): monitoring: rolling 5xx rate down to 2.3% from peak 18%.

incident-bot: Pager cleared at 12:14:09 UTC. Severity: degraded->mitigated. Handoff: oncall remains until full rollback of bypass.

maria (oncall): keeping this open for watch window 30m. Schedule follow-ups: bug: index tombstone handling; long-term: stricter checksum validation, and rehydrate rate limiter.

mike (eng-runtime): created ticket INF-3245 for index tombstone fix. Assigning to eng-runtime.

elena (sre): adding postmortem template: root cause hypothesis, timeline, impact, mitigations, action items. Will draft.

maria (oncall): thanks all. If anything regresses, re-pager and escalate to infra-leads.

sam (prod-support): posted customer note and notified top 5 customers. Closing until further updates. :white_check_mark:
